commit.author: Samuel Bharti <samuelbharti.io@gmail.com>
commit.message:
fix: stop the by_id elink warning from naming valid IDs

When entrez_link(by_id = TRUE) got fewer results than IDs sent, its
warning listed every ID, valid ones included, with a stray separator
after each. It picked the IDs with id %in% res, and res is a list of
elink objects, so nothing ever matched.

The warning now gives counts, as in "NCBI returned results for 1 of the
2 IDs requested", and no longer fires when NCBI returns more results
than IDs. It does not name IDs because the reply cannot show which ones
went unanswered. An accession comes back as a GI number, and only the
neighbor commands repeat the ID in an IdList. Matching IDs against
IdList, checked live, warns about every ID for acheck, ncheck, lcheck,
llinks and prlinks, and for accessions.

Two offline tests in test_link_errors.r use LinkSets trimmed from real
replies for accessions, ncheck and llinks. One shows a full reply of
each shape raises no warning, and the other checks the message on a
short reply.
